These are spoilers of chapters 1 to 72 of the novel:

This story is a hardcore psychological breakdown and corruption novel (NTR/Netorare) where the MC actively participates in his own destruction and that of his family.

### **The Protagonist’s Degradation (Jung Seong-min)**

* **The Initial Trauma:** Seong-min starts as a talented culinary student with a “perfect” girlfriend (Ha-young). He discovers she is engaging in “Enjo-kosai” (compensated dating). He hacks her phone and watches a progression of videos showing her systematic corruption by the antagonist, **Mr. Choi**.

* **Public Humiliation:** During the live finals of a major cooking competition, Seong-min hallucinates Ha-young’s corrupted face and ahegao expressions. He has a mental breakdown, gets an erection, and **ejaculates on live national television**, then starts masturbating in front of his family and the audience. He becomes a social pariah known as the “Full Erection Man.”

* **Total Submission:** Instead of seeking revenge immediately, he falls into a severe depression. Mr. Choi contacts him, offering him a job and access to more videos of Ha-young’s degradation. **Seong-min accepts.** He becomes a servant in Mr. Choi’s mansion, cleaning up the fluids after Mr. Choi has sex with his former loved ones.

* **Mental Corruption:** Seong-min develops a severe cuckold/masochistic fetish. He gets sexually aroused by the idea of his girlfriend, mother, and sister being corrupted. He wears a chastity cage and is only allowed to orgasm (via handjobs) once a week, usually performed by Ha-young (who mocks him) or Hee-yeon (Ha-young’s corrupted best friend).

* **The Accomplice:** To gain favor with Mr. Choi, **Seong-min provides family photos and videos to Mr. Choi**, which are used to create deepfakes to destroy his parents’ marriage. He actively desires the corruption of his mother and sister.

### **The Girlfriend’s Corruption (Lee Ha-young)**

* **The Process:** Originally innocent, she is blackmailed by Mr. Choi due to her father’s debt. She is conditioned through drugs, hypnosis, and extreme sexual acts.

* **The Result:** She transforms into a “pig slave.” She gains significant weight (up to 80kg), tans her skin dark, bleaches her hair, gets tattoos (including a womb tattoo), and has hair implanted in her armpits and anus to look “beastly.”

* **Betrayal:** She treats Seong-min like a worm, calls him “Small Dick-min” (Sil-jot-min), and abuses him physically. She views herself purely as a “waste container” for Mr. Choi.

* **The Auction:** In the later chapters provided, she is sold at a VIP auction to a morbidly obese man known as “The Savior” (another arm of Mr. Choi’s organization) to undergo “re-education” through solitary confinement and sensory deprivation until she worships this new owner as “Father.”

### **The Mother’s Corruption (Lee Shin-ah)**

* **The Trap:** Shin-ah is a classy, elegant housewife from a chaebol background who chose a normal life. Mr. Choi approaches her posing as a “psychological counselor” to help her deal with her son’s public scandal.

* **The Setup:** Mr. Choi manipulates her into entering a fitness competition and becoming an “influencer,” exposing her body to the public. He creates **deepfake videos** (using data Seong-min provided) showing her husband cheating with Ha-young to break her spirit.

* **The Fall:** Devastated by the fake infidelity, she turns to Mr. Choi for comfort. He drugs her and uses hypnosis to rewrite her personality. She engages in extreme sexual acts, is forced to recite pledges that she hates her husband and children, and eventually believes she is Mr. Choi’s “sow” destined to bear his children.

* **Failed Redemption:** When she tries to reconcile with her husband (Hyun-jae), the husband—who has developed a cuckold fetish due to his own sexual dysfunction—encourages her “roleplay,” effectively pushing her back to Mr. Choi. By Chapter 72, she is fully brainwashed, participating in “Netorase” (sharing herself) scenarios to torment her husband.

### **The Sister’s Corruption (Jung Seong-ah)**

* **The Trap:** She is a top-tier idol trainee at a major agency. Mr. Choi uses his connections to sabotage her debut lineup at the last minute.

* **The Reveal:** Desperate, she meets with a “sponsor” (Mr. Choi) who promises to make her a star. He gives her a USB drive containing videos of her idol role model (Baek Ha-yun) and other celebrities engaging in grotesque sex acts and slavery, shattering her dreams and worldview.

* **Current State:** She falls into despair. The text implies she is currently being groomed by Baek Ha-yun (who is also a broken slave of Mr. Choi) to join their ranks.

### **The Best Friend’s Corruption (Lee Hee-yeon)**

* **The Fall:** Originally trying to save Ha-young and Seong-min, she tried to gather evidence against Mr. Choi. She was seduced/broken by Mr. Choi and turned into a secondary slave.

* **Role:** She now manages Seong-min, physically abusing him and keeping him in chastity, while desperately begging him to accept her as his new owner so they can be “happy slaves” together.

### **Summary**

The story up to Chapter 72 is a downward spiral where the MC does **not** fight back. Instead, he:

1. Cleans up the semen/fluids of the villain who raped his girlfriend and mother.

2. Provides materials to help frame his father and corrupt his mother.

3. Masturbates to the idea of his sister being raped/corrupted.

4. Wears a chastity cage and thanks his abusers for allowing him to exist.

There is zero revenge in these chapters; it is pure “corruption/mind break” pornography with a humiliation fetish focus.

And here’s 73 to 113, where the “revenge” starts:

### 1. The “Turning Point” (Chapters 73–85)

The MC does snap out of his depression, but not to become a hero.

* **The Transformation:** He begs the “Master” (Mr. Choi) to teach him how to be a predator. He undergoes **penis enlargement surgery** to match the Master’s size and starts taking steroids/working out.

* **The Philosophy:** He adopts the Master’s worldview: women are just “holes” and “sows” to be conquered. He decides that to beat the Master, he must become a *better* Master.

* **The First Victim:** He takes **Hee-yeon** (Ha-young’s best friend) as his personal sex slave. He brutally rapes and breaks her mind, turning her into his “pet” rather than saving her.

### 2. The Ultimate Taboo (The Mother)

* **Total Corruption:** His mother (Lee Shin-ah) returns to the mansion, fully broken. She declares she abandons her family to be a sex slave.

* **The MC’s Role:** The MC does not save her. Instead, **he joins in.** In a masked encounter (which later becomes unmasked), the **MC has sex with his own mother** alongside the Master in a threesome. He rationalizes this as “conquering” her. He essentially becomes an active participant in his family’s destruction to “train” himself.

### 3. The Sister’s Fall (Jeong Seong-ah)

* **The Idol:** His sister debuts as an idol (“Aria”), but the Master systematically breaks her. She is forced into sponsorship prostitution.

* **The MC’s Reaction:** The MC watches the videos of his sister being raped and tortured by the Master. While he feels a pang of sadness, he suppresses it and treats it as “study material.” He plans to eventually “take her back” and make her **his** slave, not to save her as a brother.

### 4. The “Business” (Chapters 90–110)

* **The MC’s Power:** The MC starts his own criminal enterprise to rival the Master. What is the business? **Kidnapping innocent women, breaking them into sex slaves, and broadcasting it for money.**

* **New Victims:** He targets a woman named **Park Ha-rin** (a broadcasting aspirant) and a mother-son duo (**Choi Mi-ae** and **Woo Ji-chang**). He destroys their lives exactly how the Master destroyed his. He forces the son to watch his mother being raped, then forces the mother to rape the son.

* **The Goal:** He is building financial power and a slave harem so he can eventually have enough leverage to “trade” for his mother and sister.

### 5. Ha-young’s Fate

* **The “Savior”:** Ha-young was brainwashed by the other villain (The Savior/Obese Man). She was tortured in solitary confinement until she worshiped him.

* **The Reunion:** The MC meets Ha-young. She still has feelings for the MC (in a twisted way) but is loyal to the Savior.

* **The Plan:** Chapter 113 ends with the MC trying to recruit Ha-young. He wants her to betray the Savior and join him so they can overthrow the Master together. **This is the “revenge” plot.** It is two broken, evil people plotting to take over the criminal empire.

### Summary

The MC has become a **psychopath.** He is now doing to other innocent families exactly what was done to him.

* **Is he fighting back?** Yes, he is building a faction to eventually kill/dethrone the Master.

* **Is it satisfying?** Only if you enjoy seeing the MC become a worse monster than the villain. He engages in incest, rape, and sex trafficking.

**Verdict:** If you were hoping for him to save the girls and kill the bad guys, **stop reading.** If you want to read a story about a man who descends into absolute darkness to become the new “King of the Trash Heap” by out-evil-ing the villains, then this is exactly that story.
